lit.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_HOLD_DESC:
§GClick§! or £h 
Cancel the current mission and move to the nearest harbour.

§GCtrl+Click§! or £ctrl  +£h 
Cancel the current mission and stay put.
--------------
{battleship:p} held in a sea province next to a land battle can lend §HShore Fire§!.
Ships that bear wings, if held at sea, can send their wings on ordinary missions.
lit.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_NAVAL_INVASION_SUPPOR: Order ships to escort {naval_invasion:p:lc} and support them with fire on the shore.
lit.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_PATROL_DESC:
Order the task force to patrol the fleet's waters.

A task force can only patrol one region at a time.
It will try to find enemy fleets in its active region. Beacons and mastery of the sky will help it find the enemy faster.

Note that the enemy can find you and strike before you find them.
lit.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_STRIKE_FORCE_DESC:
Order the task force to wait at the nearest harbour until an enemy task force is found.
Once one of your patrol task forces finds an enemy, your strike force will move to meet it.

When not fighting the enemy, this mission uses $PERCENT|%0G$ {fuel}.

lit.SHIP_REFIT_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION:
§HRefit the chosen ships ($COUNT$) to the ship pattern $VARIANT_NAME|H$.§!

The ships will return to a nearby §H{naval_base}§! and be held there until the work is done. With the greatest number of §H{dockyard:p}§! assigned, this will take up to $DAYS|H$ days.

If the §H{naval_base}§! where they are refitted is attacked, their progress will be reduced.  If it is taken, the ships will be lost to the enemy.

Are you sure you want to refit?

lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_AREA_DEFENSE:
§HArea Defence§!
 - §GClick§! on states to add them to the army's order or remove them.
An army with this order cannot have other kinds of order at the same time.

{division:p} in an army with this order will spread over the assigned area to guard important cities, harbours and other places and to deal with small enemy forces.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DISBAND_GROUP_TOOLTIP: Click to §RDisband§! this army. Every {division:lc} in it will be left unassigned.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_DEFENCE:
§HFront Line§!
 - §GClick§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the assigned front along the whole border.
 - §GRight-click and drag the mouse§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the front over a shorter stretch.
 - §GRight-click and drag the mouse§! on the ends of an existing front line to edit them.

Front lines are the starting point of attacks into enemy land towards Offensive Lines, and they also let you place {division:p} quickly along a foreign border.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_DEFENCE_ARMY_GROUP:
§HFront Line§!
 - §GClick§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the assigned front along the whole border.
 - §GShift + Click§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the assigned front without sub-army fronts along the whole border.
 - §GRight-click and drag the mouse§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the front over a shorter stretch.
 - §GShift + Right-click and drag the mouse§! on one of the borders against another {country:lc} to set the front without sub-army fronts over a shorter stretch.
 - §GRight-click and drag the mouse§! on the ends of an existing front line to edit them.

Front lines are the starting point of attacks into enemy land towards Offensive Lines, and they also let you place {division:p} quickly along a foreign border.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_FALLBACK:
§HFallback line§!
 - §GRight-click and drag the mouse§! on friendly land to draw the §YSingle use§! defensive order.

Fallback lines are useful for placing {division:p} for defence, for example behind a river or elsewhere in friendly land.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_NAVAL_INV:
§H{naval_invasion} Order§!
Step 1) §GClick§! on one of the marked provinces to set where the landing starts.
Step 2) §GRight-click§! on the coast province(s) you wish to land in.
Once the plan is active, the landing will begin to gather and set aside {convoy:p:lc} from your realm's store.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_NAVAL_INV_WITH_HARBO:
§H{naval_invasion} Order (With a Floating {naval_base})§!
Step 1) §GClick§! on one of the marked provinces to set where the landing starts.
Step 2) §GRight-click§! on the coast province(s) you wish to land in.
Once the plan is active, the landing will begin to gather and set aside {convoy:p:lc} and a Floating {naval_base} from your {stockpile}.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_OFFENCE:
§HOffensive line§!
§GRight-click and hold the mouse button§! on the map to draw an §YOffensive Line§!.
Lines can only be drawn on land where you have set a §HFront Line§! or a §H{naval_invasion}§!.

{division:p} in a plan with an Offensive Line will try to take land and move their front line there. 

§GHold the mouse button§! and §Grelease§! it on an execute button to change how the plan is carried out
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_PARADROP:
§HSky Landing Order§!
Step 1) §GClick§! on our {air_base:lc} to set where the flight begins. The {air_base:lc} must have wings that can carry troops.
Step 2) §GRight-click§! on the province in reach of the local wings to set where the troops land.
§gRemember that only {division:p:lc} able to land from the sky will be carried.§!
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_DRAW_PARADROP_NO_PARATROO: §RNo {division:p:lc} able to land from the sky in the Command Group.§!
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_EXECUTE_TOOLTIP:
§GClick§! to $ACTION$ the carrying out of the §Ywhole plan.§!
§GShift + Click§! and then §Yclick on the order you want§! to toggle its execution
§GCtrl + Click§! to toggle the execution of all assigned {division:p:lc} and armies
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_UNASSIGN_HQ_ONLY: §RCannot take §Y{army_hq}§! {division:p:lc} out of their army. Withdraw the §Y{army_hq}§! instead.§!
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_UNASSIGN_MIXED_HQ_NOTE: §Y{army_hq}§! {division:p:lc} in the selection will be ignored.

§H{division:p} assignment mode§!
Press this button to switch the mode, or hold §GCTRL§!.
Then choose one of the marked fronts to assign the selected {division:p:lc}.
lit.UNITS_VIEW_BTN_UNITS_UNASSIGN:

Press this button to take the selected {division:p:lc} out of their orders.
